summary: W5 deterministic five-purpose closure handoff. Implement parameterized, repository-owned Cypher templates plus ArchiMate relationship-direction semantics so semantic seeds become reproducible graph ranges. Free-generated Cypher, Agent identity, text similarity, arbitrary depth, and connected-component expansion must not decide mandatory closure.
notes: Selected viewpoint: Application Usage Viewpoint. Concern: each lifecycle task receives an independently reviewable closure boundary. Purpose: deciding and handoff preparation. Affected views remain bound through the required Viewpoint description pattern.

Global approval evidence: the orchestrating W5 request explicitly asked to update intent architecture for deterministic five-purpose closure boundaries, acceptance mapping DT-06 through DT-12, and handoff production. Handoff approvedByHuman=true is recorded here as schema-compliant notes because the handoff schema does not permit an approvedByHuman field.

Dependency context: W5 starts after delivered W4 seed retrieval. grag-seed-retrieval carries deliveryStatus=delivered and deliveryEvidence.W4 for ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-04 and ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-05; W5 elements remain not_delivered until downstream implementation passes their mounted DT-06 through DT-12 entrypoints.

Scope boundary: W5 owns deterministic purpose dispatch and five independent category boundaries: intent-decision, implementation-design, coding-repair, audit, and graph-tidy. W6 endpoint closure, complete View closure, provenance, and coherent result remain downstream integrity scope and are not implementation targets of this handoff.

Release gate: all mandatory closure decisions must use named parameterized Cypher templates with bound parameters and ArchiMate relationship semantics. Free-generated Cypher may be diagnostic only and is forbidden for deciding mandatory closure.

Downstream implementation should preserve same-element entrypoints already mounted in the intent graph: runPurposePolicyClosure.js, runIntentDecisionClosure.js, runImplementationDesignClosure.js, runCodingRepairClosure.js, runAuditProofClosure.js, and runGraphTidyFullSnapshot.js.
